info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Adjusters-v4-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Adjustment Listing API enables users to access a comprehensive list of insurance claims handled by claims adjusters. This API serves insurance representatives and claims managers who need to monitor or manage the claims process. Key operations include retrieving claim details, status updates, and adjuster assignments. The API is essential for streamlining claims handling and improving communication across teams involved in the claims lifecycle.

get.summary: Retrieve claims associated with a specific adjuster.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all claims that are managed by a particular adjuster, providing insights into the claims they are handling and their status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the information related to the adjuster handling the claims. Ensure that the appropriate parameters are specified in the request body to fetch the required details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the adjuster claims data.
